                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/edisontalk/p/-/quick-start-agent-to-agent-part02" title="发布于 2025-10-09 08:00">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">多Agent协作入门：基于A2A协议的Agent通信（中）</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        
        本文介绍了A2A的三个主要角色（User、Client 和 Remote Agent）和 四个核心对象（Agent Card、Task、Artifact 和 Message），并通过简单的例子介绍了A2A协议的典型工作流程，相信对于你加深了解A2A协议会有帮助。
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><span><span>大家好，我是Edison。</span></span></p>
<p><span><a class="normal_text_link" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/edisontalk/p/19128603/quick-start-agent-to-agent-part01" target="_blank" data-itemshowtype="0" data-linktype="2"><span>上一篇</span></a><span>，我们了解了A2A协议的基本概念，还通过A2A组件实现了一个Hello World的Demo<span>，有了一个快速的感性认识。这一篇，我们来了解下A2A协议的三大角色、四大对象 以及 工作流程，有了这些基础的认知后会对我们全面认识A2A有所帮助。</span></span></span></p>
<h1><strong>A2A协议的三大角色</strong></h1>
<p>A2A 即 Agent-to-Agent，它定义了三个关键的角色，它们各司其职+互相配合，支撑多个Agent的运行。</p>
<p>那么，都是哪几个角色呢？下面告诉你：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/381412/202510/381412-20251007163403381-2078555926.png" alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p><span><span>角色1：<strong>用户（User）</strong></span></span></p>
<p><span><span>即终端用户（可能是人类 或 服务），需要使用Agent来完成某个任务。</span></span></p>
<p><span><span>角色2：<strong>客户端（Client）</strong></span></span></p>
<p><span><span>一个代表用户向 远程Agent 发送请求的实体，它发送的请求是严格按照A2A协议的。它的表现形式可以是一个应用程序、服务 或 一个Agent。</span></span></p>
<p><span><span>例如，我们在上一篇的Demo中开发的一个控制台应用程序通过引用A2A包来向远端的Agent发送请求。</span></span></p>
<p><span><span>角色3：<strong>远程Agent（Remote Agent）</strong></span></span></p>
<p>一个执行实际任务的Agent（部署在某个远端Server上），对于客户端来说是“黑盒”一样的存在，仅仅通过Agent Card声明自己提供的接口或技能，但内部实现细节或工作机制是不透明的，即一个“黑盒”。</p>
<p><span><span>例如，我们在上一篇的Demo中开发的一个WebAPI项目EchoAgent，提供了一个ProcessMessage的技能 以及 声明了一个AgentCard公开了一些元数据。</span></span></p>
<h1><span>A2A的四大对象</span></h1>
<p><span><span>A2A中定义了一套完整的对象体系，其中最核心的就是下面这四个核心对象：</span></span></p>
<h3><span><span>第一个对象：<span><strong>Agent Card</strong><span>（又称Agent名片）</span></span></span></span></h3>
<p><span><span>每个A2A的远程Agent都需要发布一个JSON格式的名片，被称为“Agent Card”，用于描述这个Agent具有哪些技能 及其 认证机制，便于Client可以获得这些信息并选择合适的Agent来完成任务。</span></span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/381412/202510/381412-20251007163441209-850678960.png" alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p><span><span>其实，它就和我们在做后端服务开发中的服务注册和发现的机制差不多，只不过这个注册的信息被标准化了，下面我们可以看看一个典型的Agent Card的JSON格式：</span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">name</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Google Maps Agent</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">description</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Plan routes, remember places, and generate directions</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">url</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">https://maps-agent.google.com</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">provider</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">organization</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Google</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,

  },
  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">version</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">1.0.0</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">authentication</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">schemes</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">OAuth2</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
  },
  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">defaultInputModes</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: [<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">text/plain</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">],
  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">defaultOutputModes</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: [<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">text/plain</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">application/html</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">],
  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">capabilities</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">streaming</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">pushNotifications</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
  },
  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">skills</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: [
    {
      </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">route-planner</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
      </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">name</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Route planning</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,

        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">plan my route from Sunnyvale to Mountain View</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">what's the commute time from Sunnyvale to San Francisco at 9AM</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
      ],

    }
  ]
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p><span><span>这个JSON数据简要描述了一个名为"Google Maps Agent"的Agent定义。这个Agent的主要功能是规划路线、记住地点和生成导航指示。这个应用由Google提供，版本号是1.0.0，采用OAuth2身份验证。它支持文本和HTML格式的输入和输出，具有流媒体功能，但不支持推送通知。它的一个核心技能是"route-planner"，可以帮助用户规划两个地点之间的路线，并输出HTML和视频格式的内容。</span></span></p>
<p><span><span><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;section&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;letter-spacing: 0.578px;text-align: left;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;section&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;margin: 8px;line-height: 1.75em;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot; outline: 0px; visibility: visible; line-height: 1.75em; margin-bottom: 8px; margin-top: 8px;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><span>在A2A .NET SDK中，AgentCard的定义如下：</span></span></span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AgentCard
{
&nbsp; &nbsp; </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> Name { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span>; } &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 代理名称</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
&nbsp; &nbsp; </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> Description { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span>; } &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 代理描述</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
&nbsp; &nbsp; </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> Url { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span>; } &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 代理 URL</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
&nbsp; &nbsp; </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> AgentProvider? Provider { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span>; } &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 提供商信息</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
&nbsp; &nbsp; </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> Version { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span>; } &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 版本信息</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
&nbsp; &nbsp; </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> AgentCapabilities Capabilities { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span>; } <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 代理能力</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
&nbsp; &nbsp; </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> List&lt;AgentSkill&gt; Skills { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span>; } &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 代理技能</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
&nbsp; &nbsp; </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> List&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>&gt; DefaultInputModes { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span>; } <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 默认输入模式</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
&nbsp; &nbsp; </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> List&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>&gt; DefaultOutputModes { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span>; }<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 默认输出模式</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p><span><span>在上一篇的Demo中，我们在定义EchoAgent时，就实现了一个GetAgentCard方法，并将其注册到服务发现中最终被Client探索发现时就会以JSON格式输出给到Client：</span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> EchoAgent
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Attach(ITaskManager taskManager)
    {
        taskManager.OnMessageReceived </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ProcessMessageAsync;
        taskManager.OnAgentCardQuery </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> GetAgentCardAsync;
    }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> Task&lt;Message&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ProcessMessageAsync(MessageSendParams messageSendParams, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        ......
    }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> Task&lt;AgentCard&gt; GetAgentCardAsync(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> agentUrl, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> Task.FromResult(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AgentCard
        {
            Name </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Echo Agent</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            Description </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Echoes messages back to the user</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            Url </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> agentUrl,
            Version </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">1.0.0</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            DefaultInputModes </span>= [<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">text</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">],
            DefaultOutputModes </span>= [<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">text</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">],
            Capabilities </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> AgentCapabilities { Streaming = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> }
        });
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>与此同时，在Client中也可以主动进行服务发现，例如上一篇Demo中的Client示例代码：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Discover agent and create client</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> cardResolver = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> A2ACardResolver(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Uri(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">https://localhost:7243/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">));
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> agentCard = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cardResolver.GetAgentCardAsync();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> client = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> A2AClient(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Uri(agentCard.Url));</pre>
</div>
<h3><span><span>第二个对象：<span>Task&nbsp;<span>（任务）</span></span></span></span></h3>
<p><span><span>Task 是 Client 和 远程Agent 之间协作的一个概念，很好理解，一个Task代表一个需要完成的任务，每个Task都有一个唯一的ID号，它通常包含了任务状态、历史记录 和 执行结果 等信息。</span></span></p>
<p><span><span>Task的主要具体状态有：submitted, working, completed, canceled, failed 等，下图展示了Task的状态机转换流。</span></span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/381412/202510/381412-20251007163643882-93949972.png" alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p><span><span><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;section&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;letter-spacing: 0.578px;text-align: left;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;section&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;margin: 8px;line-height: 1.75em;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);outline: 0px;visibility: visible;line-height: 1.75em;margin-bottom: 8px;margin-top: 8px;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><span>在A2A .NET SDK中，AgentTask的定义如下：</span></span></span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AgentTask : A2AResponse
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> Id { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span>; }                      <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 任务 ID</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>? ContextId { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span>; }              <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 上下文 ID</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> AgentTaskStatus Status { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span>; }         <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 任务状态</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> List&lt;Artifact&gt;? Artifacts { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span>; }      <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 任务产出物</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> List&lt;Message&gt;? History { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span>; }         <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 消息历史</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> Dictionary&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>, JsonElement&gt;? Metadata { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span>; } <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 元数据</span>
}</pre>
</div>
<h3><span><span>第三个对象：<span>Artifact<span>（工件 或 成果）</span></span></span></span></h3>
<p><span><span>Artifact 和我们在DevOps CI/CD流水线中的Artifact（即工件）的概念类似，它是 远程Agent执行完某个任务后生成输出的结果（即远程Agent返回的结果通过一个Artifact对象输出给Client），每个任务的结果可能都不一样。</span></span></p>
<p><span><span>一个Artifact可以包含多个部分（parts），每个部分（part）可以是：文本、文档、图像 等，涉及纯文本、文件 和 结构化数据。</span></span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/381412/202510/381412-20251007163713196-509601176.png" alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<h3><span><span>第四个对象：<span>Message<span>（消息）</span></span></span></span></h3>
<p><span><span><span><span>Message 也很好理解，它就是 Client 和 远程Agent 之间通信的 一个消息对象，它通常包含了 指令 和 状态更新 等内容。</span></span></span></span></p>
<p><span><span><span><span>同样的，一个Message对象也可以包含多个parts，用于传递如 文本、文件 或 结构化 等不同类型的内容。每个Message都有发送方设置的一个唯一的messageId，且通过一些关键词如"user"（代表Client发送的）或“agent”（代表服务端发送的）来区分角色。</span></span></span></span></p>
<p><span><span><span><span><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;section&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;letter-spacing: 0.578px;text-align: left;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;section&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;margin: 8px;line-height: 1.75em;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;section&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);outline: 0px;visibility: visible;line-height: 1.75em;margin-bottom: 8px;margin-top: 8px;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><span>在A2A .NET SDK中，Message的定义如下：</span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Message : A2AResponse
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> MessageRole Role { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span>; }               <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 消息角色 (User/Agent)</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> List&lt;Part&gt; Parts { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span>; }               <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 消息部分</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>? MessageId { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span>; }              <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 消息 ID</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>? TaskId { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span>; }                 <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 关联任务 ID</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>? ContextId { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span>; }              <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 上下文 ID</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> Dictionary&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>, JsonElement&gt;? Metadata { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span>; } <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 元数据</span>
}</pre>
</div>
<h1><span><span><span><span><strong><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;section&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;letter-spacing: 0.578px;text-align: left;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;section&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;margin: 8px;line-height: 1.75em;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;section&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;margin-top: 8px;margin-bottom: 8px;outline: 0px;visibility: visible;line-height: 1.75em;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;node&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;strong&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]">A2A协议的工作流程</span></strong></span></span></span></span></h1>
<p>这里我们来通过一个简单的例子看看A2A协议的 请求-响应 工作流程是怎么样的。</p>
<p><span><span><span><span><span><span>例如，有这样一个场景“招聘XX岗位候选人搜寻”：</span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p><span><span><span><span><span><span><strong>Step1</strong><span>，用户在统一界面下向Client（假设它也是一个Agent）发送一个请求消息“请帮我寻找一个XX岗位的候选人”。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p><span><span><span><span><span><span><strong>Step2</strong><span>，Client将用户的请求消息进行封装，并根据岗位需求依次调用一些远程Agent如 简历检索Agent、技能筛选Agent 等等。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p><span><span><span><span><span><span>例如，下面的请求示例展示了Client在检索了5位候选人简历之后通过A2A协议向远端技能筛选Agent发送的任务请求：</span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">jsonrpc</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">2.0</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">method</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">tasks/send</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">params</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">de38c76d-d54c-436c-8b9f-4c2703648d64</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">message</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: {
      </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">role</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">user</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
      </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">parts</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: [
        {
          </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">type</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">text</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
          </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">text</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">请分析下面5位候选人是否符合岗位需求，并推荐最佳面试人选。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        }
      ]
    },
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">metadata</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: {}
  }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p><span><span><span><span><span><span><span><strong>Step3</strong><span>，各个远端Agent执行各自的任务，并返回给Client对应的Artifact对象结果（如候选人名单等），然后再由Client进行汇总和展示。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">jsonrpc</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">2.0</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">result</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">de38c76d-d54c-436c-8b9f-4c2703648d64</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">sessionId</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">c295ea44-7543-4f78-b524-7a38915ad6e4</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">status</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: {
      </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">state</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">completed</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    },
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">artifacts</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: [
      {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">name</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">result</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">parts</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: [
          {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">type</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">text</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">text</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">第三位候选人最符合你的需求!建议安排面试。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
          }
        ]
      }
    ],
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">metadata</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: {}
  }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p><span><span><span><span><span><span><span><span><span><span><strong>Step4</strong><span>，后续Client可以陆续调用其他远端Agent如 面试安排Agent、背景调查Agent等，完成端到端的自动化招聘流程。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p><span><span><span><span><span><span><span><span><span><span>那么，该场景的整个工作流程便如下图所示：</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/381412/202510/381412-20251007163917707-837737863.png" alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p><span><span><span><span><span><span><span><span><span><span><span><span>除此之外，实际应用案例中通常是<span>A2A与MCP两个协议一起使用<span>，形成更广的应用范围。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p><span><span><span><span><span><span><span><span><span><span><span><span>例如，下图展示了一个汽车维修店的场景，店长智能体 和 机械师智能体 通过A2A协议完成任务移交（hand-off），店长可以处理常见问题，但机械师可以解决技术难题。机械师智能体再通过MCP协议完成<strong>内部工具使用</strong>完成具体任务，还可以通过A2A协议和零件供应商Agent完成<strong>外部协作</strong>。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/381412/202510/381412-20251007163953239-2087458402.png" alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p><span><span><span><span><span><span><span><span><span><span><span><span>由此可见，其实在企业客服 或 售后中心 等场景中，A2A协议可以被广泛应用于多Agent协作。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h1><span><span><span><span><span><span><span><span><span><span><span><span><strong><span>小结</span></strong></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></h1>
<p>本文介绍了A2A的三个主要角色（User、Client 和 Remote Agent）以及 四个核心对象（Agent Card、Task、Artifact 和 Message），并通过简单的例子介绍了A2A协议的典型工作流程，相信对于你加深了解A2A协议会有帮助。</p>
<p>下一篇，我们将以一个旅行规划的应用场景，结合LLM大模型来实现一个A2A协议的案例，它会涉及一个Client 和 三个Remote Agent，是一个拿来练手的好案例<span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;section&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;letter-spacing: 0.578px;text-align: left;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;section&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;font-style: normal;font-variant-ligatures: normal;font-variant-caps: normal;text-transform: none;word-spacing: 0px;-webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px;white-space: normal;text-align: left;margin: 8px;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;node&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;strong&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]">。</span></p>
